worldcombat.skill.harden.summary: Raise Defense and soften incoming hits. A heavy blow can break the protection early.
worldcombat.skill.harden.use.0: Crystallize before a burst and blunt every hit
worldcombat.skill.harden.use.1: Keep a cheap shell up and trade hits
worldcombat.skill.harden.use.2: Hold against a flurry of small hits - one heavy blow is the danger
worldcombat.skill.harden.description.0: Shelled: Defense +%1$s stages, each hit loses %2$s of its damage, for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.harden.description.1: A single hit reaching %1$s of maximum health cracks the shell at once; it is built from about %2$s crystal facets and wraps a %3$s-block radius.
worldcombat.skill.harden.deep.on: Deep hardening: thicker shell, more softening, harder to crack, lasts longer, at the cost of a 3-tick longer telegraph and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.harden.deep.off: Light hardening: a thin shell that softens less and cracks under one heavy blow, but telegraphs and cools down much sooner, so it can be reapplied often.
worldcombat.skill.harden.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.harden.growth.0: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.harden.growth.1: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.harden.preference.deep: On: thicker shell, more softening, harder to crack, lasts longer, at the cost of a 3-tick longer telegraph and a longer cooldown. Off: a thin shell that cracks easily but telegraphs and cools down much sooner.
worldcombat.skill.harden.preference.ai.m: Consider crystallizing when a threat is within this distance; larger prepares earlier.
worldcombat.skill.harden.preference.ai.p: Below this health fraction the companion crystallizes ahead of the shared order; higher enters the hardening stance earlier, lower waits until nearly down.
